description: Show the user an interactive form for the four values every other tool assumes — Fitzpatrick skin type, fraction of skin exposed, age and target IU — with the minutes they need updating live. Use this when those values are unknown, when the user wants to change them, or instead of asking for them one at a time in conversation. Whatever the user picks comes back into the conversation; pass those values explicitly to the other tools afterwards.

age.description: Age in years (synthesis declines with age); omit for adult baseline

exposedSkinFraction.description: Skin exposed: 0.10 face+hands, 0.18 face+arms, 0.25 t-shirt+shorts (default), 0.40 swimsuit

lat.description: Latitude of the place being discussed, so the live estimate uses today's real UV there

placeName.description: How to label that place in the widget

skinType.description: Fitzpatrick skin type 1 (very fair) to 6 (very dark); default 3

targetIU.description: Vitamin D target per session in IU; default 1000

timezone.description: IANA timezone like 'Europe/Madrid'. Strongly recommended — without it all times are UTC

name: configure_sun_profile
